big_picture.summary_en: Soft July US payrolls of -23k jobs triggered sharp rise in rate cut probabilities and equity rally. The new 15% tariff on polysilicon raises material costs for semiconductor supply chains.

issues.title_en: July US Payrolls Contract 23k, Rate Cut Odds Surge
issues.current_state_en: US employers cut 23,000 jobs in July against expectations of gains; futures rose and September Fed hike odds collapsed.
issues.current_state_ko: 7월 미국 고용이 예상과 달리 2.3만명 감소하며 선물 상승, 9월 Fed 금리인상 확률 급락.
issues.novelty_en: First negative payroll print in years; immediate repricing of 2026 rate path after prior hot-data streak.
issues.novelty_ko: 수년 만의 마이너스 고용 지표, 기존 강한 데이터 흐름 후 금리 경로 즉시 재조정.
issues.summary_en: Soft July jobs data triggered equity rally and sharp drop in hike probabilities. Multiple outlets including CNBC, WSJ and NBC New York reported the -23k print and market reaction within hours.
issues.summary_ko: 7월 고용 지표 부진으로 주가 상승과 금리인상 확률 급락. CNBC·WSJ·NBC가 수시간 내 보도.

issues.market_insight_en: Watch 10y yield and Fed funds futures for further downside; any bounce in yields caps equity gains.

issues.title_en: Trump Imposes 15% Tariff on Key Semiconductor Material
issues.title_ko: 트럼프, 핵심 반도체 소재 15% 관세 부과
issues.current_state_en: 15% tariff announced on polysilicon and related chip inputs to counter China; targets solar and semiconductor supply chains.
issues.current_state_ko: 중국 견제 목적으로 폴리실리콘 등 반도체 핵심 소재에 15% 관세 발표, 태양광·반도체 공급망 영향.
issues.novelty_en: New tariff level and explicit chip-material scope confirmed Aug 7 after Aug 6 Politico leak; immediate sector rotation into domestic materials names.
issues.novelty_ko: 8월 6일 Politico 보도 후 8월 7일 15% 관세와 반도체 소재 명시 확인, 내수 소재주로 즉시 섹터 이동.
issues.summary_en: Tariff directly raises input costs for chip and solar manufacturers reliant on Chinese polysilicon. BBC, Politico and Simply Wall St. reported the measure within 24 hours with explicit semiconductor linkage.
issues.summary_ko: 중국산 폴리실리콘 의존 반도체·태양광 업체 원가 상승. BBC·Politico·Simply Wall St. 24시간 내 보도.
issues.asymmetric_impact_en: NVDA: negative (higher material costs, supply risk); TSM: negative (upstream cost pressure); MU: negative (memory supply chain exposure)
issues.asymmetric_impact_ko: NVDA: 부정 (소재비 상승·공급 리스크); TSM: 부정; MU: 부정
issues.market_insight_en: Monitor polysilicon futures and any exemptions list; domestic US materials or non-China supply names may see relative outperformance.
issues.market_insight_ko: 폴리실리콘 선물과 면제 목록 주시, 중국 비의존 내수 소재주 상대 강세 가능.
